title: zone
intro:
A subset of 3D space.
   Used by SoilRegion @ volume (see 107.20, page 613) .

sections.name: box
sections.desc:
A zone defined by intervals on each axis. By default, the intervals fill the entire
axis. You can modify this by setting the parameters.
sections.sig:
< box (top top )               ; Default empty value.
            (bottom bottom ) ; Default empty value.
            (left left )         ; Default empty value.
            (right right )       ; Default empty value.
            (front front )       ; Default empty value.
            (back back )         ; Default empty value. >

sections.name: polygon
sections.desc:
A 2D region defined by points connected by lines. The object is assumed to be
infinite in the third dimension.

attrs.name: outer
attrs.doc:
Points surrounding the polygon in clockwise order.
          <    z x   >
          – z : number [cm]
            Parameter
            Vertical position.
          – x : number [cm]
            Parameter
            Horizontal position.
